summary: Verified per-event Open Graph endpoint (GET /api/events/{id}/og) and ShareButtons wiring. Backend: all 31 pytest tests pass (backend_test.py incl. TestEventOgPage + test_org_images.py). OG endpoint for evt-festival-2026 returns 200 text/html with correct og:type=event, og:site_name='Blackrod Now', og:title, og:description (contains date/venue/description), og:image (absolute https to Unsplash event image), og:url (absolute canonical), twitter:card=summary_large_image + twitter:{title,description,image}, plus <link rel=canonical>, <meta http-equiv=refresh> and <script>window.location.replace(...)</script>. 404 correctly returned for missing event. Frontend: intercepted window.open on /events/evt-festival-2026 and confirmed Facebook/LinkedIn/X-Twitter/WhatsApp share buttons all use the URL-encoded backend OG endpoint (…/api/events/evt-festival-2026/og), while Copy link + Instagram write the pretty canonical /events/evt-festival-2026 URL to clipboard. Grep of /app/frontend/src confirms no 'noopener,noreferrer,width' feature string anywhere. OrgDashboard's ShareButtons usage (no ogUrl prop) correctly falls back to canonicalUrl — no crash risk.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1211 lines — approaching the 700-line 'split modules' threshold in the review guidelines. Consider extracting routers (events, orgs, subscribers, newsletter, images, og) into separate modules in a future refactor. Not blocking.

The OG endpoint's description truncation at 280 chars can cut mid-word (e.g. '...February 20' visible in curl output). Consider trimming to nearest word boundary for prettier previews. Minor polish, not a bug.

og:image currently emits & via html.escape which is correct for HTML but some naive Facebook scrapers historically had issues with entity-encoded ampersands in og:image URLs — Facebook Debugger (developers.facebook.com/tools/debug) will confirm, but nothing to fix now.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OG endpoint at /api/events/{id}/og is stable and covered by TestEventOgPage in backend_test.py. ShareButtons.jsx accepts optional ogUrl prop; when absent it uses canonicalUrl for all platforms (verified via OrgDashboard usage). Frontend test uses window.open + navigator.clipboard.writeText interception to sniff URLs — note that the real clipboard write triggers a 'Couldn't copy caption' toast in headless due to browser permission, but the intercepted URLs are correct. This is a test-env artifact, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
